openings.claim: Explore reversible edge-bearing registration: lateral load would pass through hatch-edge stops into removable rim anchors; straps provide separation restraint. If geometry permits, four strips form two opposed pad-protected bolted anchors; existing bolts bear against edges without penetrating originals. Balance two straps across 180 mm, cord-tether hardware, and remove assemblies clear of the marked opening for access.
openings.discriminator: Against balanced friction-only retention, positive bearing should reduce displacement sensitivity to reduced seal pressure. The right-side card may still cause rocking; bearing does not establish seating, seal survival or reopening time. Inaccessible anchoring, inadequate strap reach, excessive rocking or failed timing defeats the proposal.
openings.probe: Untensioned mock-up checks opposed bearing, accessible reversible anchoring, 250 mm strap reach, hardware recovery and full opening clearance. Reject fabrication if forbidden alteration or extra resources are needed. If feasible, drill only strips; use at most two preliminary closure/pull trials for seating, then ten opening/closure/pull trials with the supplied 1 mm card at the marked right contact on final closure. Measure marked-position error and displacement under 20 N, time one-technician reopening, and inspect seal every cycle. Stop on new tears or unstable hardware; stopping is not passing. Respect twelve total trials and at most two configurations, each requiring disturbance.
openings.uncertainty: Rim profile/underside access and effective existing-bolt edge contacts are unverified. Verify supplied material sufficiency, strap/1 m cord reach, ninety-minute fabrication and twenty-minute observation capacity. Three stipulated 2 mm opposite-corner lifts motivate balance but do not establish cause.

lineage.reason: Retains load separation, opposed reversible geometry, comparative prediction, disturbed test, uncertain fit and resource/stopping gates.

decision: Fabrication-gated probe only. Accept only within 1 mm after ten cycles, withstand 20 N, reopen within 30 seconds, full unobstructed opening, recoverable loose components and no new visible seal tears. No drilling, cutting, gluing or permanent deformation of originals; no powered mechanism. All outcomes remain required under final disturbance except seal-contact continuity.
